contentText: The U.S. government should be conducting itself with "Strength. Force. And Power" according to senior White House aide Stephen Miller.The deputy chief of staff for policy is part of Trump's inner circle, oversees a staff of forty people and is the homeland security advisor. He has long pushed hard-right domestic policies such as mass deportations and more recently has set his sights to overseas territories. Who is Stephen Miller and how did he rise to such a prominent position?
